title: mo roles file schema
description: Schema for the mo roles configuration file. Defines agent roles, their prompts, context budgets, and LLM model assignments.

schema_version.description: Schema contract version for the roles file format.

default_llm_id.description: Default canonical LLM identifier (provider:model-slug) used when a role does not specify its own llm_id.

model_defaults.description: Default LLM model configuration for the layer.

roles.description: Map of role names to their definitions.

prompt_template.description: System prompt template for the role. Supports {{variable}} substitution only. No eval or code execution.

context_budget.description: Fraction of the model context window allocated to this role (0-1).

llm_id.description: Canonical LLM identifier (provider:model-slug) for this role. null means inherit the layer's default_llm_id.
